note: Every dispatch of the v5 grid on the max, by grid, size and run range. 'kept' runs count toward their squares; 'cancelled' runs count toward nothing. Later dispatches are named by their squares (run-name) and found by scripts/dispatch_grid.py itself. With the cluster inside (six-kube, and the rented machines of those squares), the dispatches listed here are protocol 1 (before the amendment of 12 Oct, docs/K8S_COMPASS_PREREGISTRATION.md): kept and archived, counted in no square; the squares are filled on protocol 2, read from the runs' names. The grid is 1, 10 and 100 only (the founder's order of 12 October, evening): the 1,000-copy and 1,000-run dispatches listed here, and the rented machines of the 1,000-copy squares, count in no square.
